title: Map RSOS-Ising model to vertex model
action: Construct the transfer matrix of the RSOS-Ising coupled model with ε=1, α=0.5, J=0.15 by mapping to a decorated 6-state vertex model (304 nonzero weights). Produce the matrix elements and structure for the PWFRG iteration.
description: Define the vertex weights and transfer matrix structure used throughout the computation.

title: Run PWFRG to obtain fixed-point wavefunctions
action: Implement the product-wavefunction renormalization group (PWFRG) algorithm to iterate the transfer matrix to the thermodynamic fixed point. For the five temperatures k_B T/ε = 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5 and a range of Andreev fields η, compute the dominant eigenvector (fixed-point wavefunction). Retain enough states for convergence.
description: Record the fixed-point wavefunction information for each (T, η) so that downstream steps can compute observables.

title: Compute p(η) curves
action: For each temperature and η value, calculate the thermal average surface gradient p as the expectation of the vertical edge variable from the fixed-point wavefunction. Store the resulting (η, p) data points for every temperature.
description: Intermediate data for the p–η relation, used for subsequent fitting.

title: Fit η(p) and extract step properties
action: For each temperature, fit the p(η) data to the polynomial η = A0 + A2 p^2 + A3 p^3 + A4 p^4 via least squares. Set step tension γ = A0 and compute step stiffness γ̃(0) = π² (k_B T)² / (2 A2). Write the extracted coefficients and derived properties to step_properties.csv.
description: CSV file containing the fitted step tension γ, coefficient A2, and step stiffness γ̃ at the five studied temperatures.
output_schema: Header: temperature,gamma,A2,gamma_tilde. temperature: float (units k_B T/ε); gamma: float (units ε); A2: float (coefficient in η(p) polynomial); gamma_tilde: float (units ε). Rows for temperatures 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5.
